description: The United States Army Corps of Engineers Europe District intends on awarding a sole-source contract to REBUILDING UKRAINE ASSOCIATION INCORPORATED (UEI: VLY9VCFK1NF4) in an amount not to exceed $250,000 for three courses tied to partnership training related to moving a direct execution agency to a modern project management organization.  This is a non-commercial procurement under RFO 13.101(b).
